## BITE WOUNDS WITH PASTEURELLA MULTOCIDA
## Treatment ##Inpatient
[Amoxicillin-clavulanate 875/125 mg PO q12h ($) [R] < OR >](psjzid-amox-clav-875-125mg-po-q12h)
[Ampicillin-sulbactam 1.5-3 gm IV q6h ($$) [R]](psjizid-ampicillin-sulbactam-3gm-iv-q6h)
## Alternative for penicillin allergy
[Doxycycline 100mg PO q12h ($) [DI] < OR >](psjzid-doxycycline-100mg-po-q12h)
[Doxycycline 100mg IV q12h ($$) [DI]](psjizid-doxycycline-100mg-iv-q12h)
## Outpatient

## Treatment for infection without joint involvement
## __________________________________________________
Treat for 10 days.
[Amoxicillin-clavulanate 875/125 mg PO BID ($) [R]](psozid2-amox-clav-875-125mg-10ds-po-bid)
[Non-VA order for above](pshzid2-amox-clav-875-125mg-10ds-po-bid)
## Alternative for penicillin allergy
[Doxycycline 100mg PO BID ($) [DI]](psozid2-doxycycline-10ds-100mg-po-bid)
Non-VA order for above
